description: Heuristic evaluation (BME Design Section 8.2.5.2, Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics; IEC 62366-1 formative evaluation). Performed by the design team on the working prototype, so it is a formative self-assessment, not a substitute for summative usability testing with clinicians (see docs/07 validation plan). 'met' counts toward SPEC-12; 'partial' does not.

live.evidence: Alert banner always in the same position with level, reason, confidence and 'held' indicator; per-update latency, regime and signal quality shown; playback clock.

review.evidence: Progress state while the review runs; summary tiles show monitored time, abstention % and episode count.

heuristics.name: Match between system and the real world

live.evidence: Bedside-monitor layout (ECG II / PLETH / ART strips, dark monitor panel); clinical units (mmHg); thresholds stated as 65 target / 55 critical.

review.evidence: Plain-language handoff narrative written in clinical terms (time at CRITICAL, MAP change after vasopressor).

live.evidence: Play/pause, step, restart, speed and start position are available, but a confirmed intervention mark cannot be undone (only restarted). Design iteration item.

review.evidence: Any recording can be re-reviewed; exports open separately without losing the page.

live.evidence: IEC 60601-1-8 priority colours plus shape icons (colour-blind safe); identical layout and controls for Concepts A and B so the alert banner never moves (BME Design 8.2.5.3 alarm-silence lesson).

review.evidence: Same level colours and names as the live views and the printable report.

live.evidence: Two-click confirmation for marking an intervention (auto-cancels after 4 s); server validates every request (size limit, unknown IDs, session cap).

review.evidence: Only held-out recordings can be selected; generation is a single explicit action.

live.evidence: Legends on every chart; 'How alerts work' panel defines every level; reason text explains why the level is shown.

review.evidence: Episode table lists start, end, worst level and lowest MAP - no need to remember the timeline.

live.evidence: Keyboard shortcuts (Space, →), playback speeds 1-20x, start presets at the clinically interesting moment.

review.evidence: Printable report for handoff plus CSV/JSON for audit and research.

live.evidence: One dominant alert banner; R/C and log are secondary; verification overlay hidden by default.

review.evidence: Summary first, details below; report fits on printed pages.

heuristics.name: Help users recognise, diagnose and recover from errors

live.evidence: Errors shown in a dedicated alert box with the action to take ('Press Restart to begin again'); SIGNAL CHECK tells the user to check sensors.

review.evidence: Error message shown in place if a review cannot be generated.

live.evidence: Inline help panel; design documents (this Design History File) readable inside the app.

review.evidence: Report states method, thresholds and limitations; design documents available in the app.
